notes: No xtext evidence: the pilot has no AssignmentTargetBinding rule. This production is also the one place NonFeatureChainPrimaryExpression earns its existence, which bears on the standing question of why the NonFeatureChainPrimaryArgument pair is unreachable.
decision: A transcription of SysML 8.2.2.17.5: `ownedRelatedElement += NonFeatureChainPrimaryExpression`. It contributes no tokens of its own; the prefix expression it holds is written below it. The choice of NonFeatureChainPrimaryExpression rather than a general expression is the load-bearing part and is the clause's own: a feature chain is excluded here precisely because the '.' that would continue the chain belongs to AssignmentTargetParameter, so admitting one would make `counter.count` ambiguous between a chain and a prefix-plus-feature. There is no second opinion to weigh: the pinned pilot grammar has no rule of this name, reaching the same position through TargetBinding behind a '=>' syntactic predicate.

evidence.note: States the production; the rule is its transcription.
In line 20 `entry assign counter.count := 0;` this production holds `counter`, the part before the '.' that AssignmentTargetParameter carries.
